text:
maria: Quick check — onboarding weaver-13b-v2. I found weights at gs://redwood-models/weaver/13b/v2/weights.pt (not sure about the manifest). Tokenizer seems to split EM-dash and some unicode ligatures incorrectly in our eval set. License file included in repo looks like 'LICENSE.md' but isn't one of the usual SPDX ids. Can infra + legal confirm serving readiness? cc @ajay @sara @lucas-legal

ajay: I can verify the weights path. Ran `gsutil ls -l gs://redwood-models/weaver/13b/v2/` — there's weights.pt + config.json + tokenizer.json. SHA256 (partial): `b1f3c9e...9a`. Paste of ls: 
```
gs://redwood-models/weaver/13b/v2/weights.pt
gs://redwood-models/weaver/13b/v2/config.json
gs://redwood-models/weaver/13b/v2/tokenizer.json
```
Also added a `weights_manifest.json` to the bucket (ACL: internal by default).

sara: Repro for tokenizer oddness: it splits 'king—queen' into ['king', '—', 'queen'] which shifts token alignment in our evals. Repro snippet:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
tok.encode('king—queen').tokens
```
Suggest a short pre-tokenize mapping EM-DASH -> ' - ' until we train a new tokenizer.

darren: Serving recommendations for Dedicated: use `quantization: q4_0`, `max_seq_len: 2048`, `kv_cache: on`. Batching policy: `latency_slo_ms: 50`, `max_batch: 32`. Example config:
```
model_variant: \"weaver-13b-v2-q4\"
quant: \"q4_0\"
max_seq_len: 2048
batching:
  latency_slo_ms: 50
  max_batch: 32
```
I'll stage a canary with fallback to `weaver-13b-v2-fp16` for safety.

lucas-legal: I reviewed LICENSE.md — it's a custom license. Key points: (1) commercial use allowed, (2) requires explicit attribution in product UI, (3) prohibits use for targeted political persuasion. We need the model card to include the full license text, the required attribution string, and a short training-data provenance summary. If any upstream checkpoint used a CC-BY-NC or similar, that would block commercial hosting — confirm `parent_checkpoint` provenance.

maria: Action items: (1) @ajay confirm weights_manifest ACL + add `parent_checkpoint` field (EOD) (2) @sara add tokenizer preproc patch + unit test (PR) (3) @darren create canary config + rollout plan (4) @lucas-legal if license OK, add compliance tag `license:requires-attribution` to model registry. I'll file an onboarding ticket with links.

ajay: weights_manifest is internal-only right now; changed ACL to `internal`. SHA256 full: `b1f3c9e2a7d4...9a3c`. Updated manifest with `parent_checkpoint: weaver-13b-open`.

sara: opened PR #492 with small pre-tokenizer mapping EM-DASH -> ' - ' and tests. CI green locally, pushed for review. cc @darren for canary verification.

darren: I will spin a canary tomorrow AM in us-west2: route 1% traffic for 6h -> 10% -> 100% if metrics look good. Fallback policy to prefer `weaver-13b-v2-fp16` on OOM/errors. Will attach deploy config to onboarding ticket.

lucas-legal: One more requirement: model card must include an explicit \"Attribution\" snippet. Proposed text: 'This model includes weights derived from the open checkpoint \"weaver-13b-open\" and is distributed under a custom license that requires attribution: \"Model weights and derived outputs must display: \\\"Weaver-13b-v2 (Redwood Inference)\\\".\"' If that wording is acceptable I'll add it to the registry entry.

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll mark the ticket as `pre-gate` until legal + infra confirm the few outstanding items. :thumbsup:
